derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G1519 (εἰς) and G2965 (κύων) and G906 (βάλλω);
def: what is thrown to the dogs, i.e. refuse (ordure)

occurrences.text: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
